question: Does holding all three identity-initialized task frames inactive until update 120 prevent early coadaptation from selecting directions nearly orthogonal to the useful frozen-endpoint directions?

evidence.interpretation: The frames are sufficiently large and gradient-connected but select the wrong local directions while the dense bases are changing fastest.

candidate.base: byte-identical accepted full-attention plus Muon-matched hidden64+24 c_proj decay-1 error-feedback recipe and byte-identical three-frame capacity
candidate.only_scientific_change: set all pre-GELU, post-GELU hidden, and residual-output frame gradients to None for updates 0 through 119; activate all at update 120
candidate.frame_optimizer_state_before_start: absent because AdamW receives None gradients; exact identity coordinates are retained
candidate.pregelu_frame: two-stage fixed-basis block32/basis256 rotation, coordinate scale 4, seed 161803
candidate.postgelu_hidden_frame: two-stage fixed-basis block32/basis256 rotation, coordinate scale 4, seed 314159
candidate.residual_output_frame: four-stage fixed-basis block32/basis256 rotation, coordinate scale 4, seed 271828

decision_rule.pass: stable terminal validation CE at or below 5.522365207672119, improving the accepted causal parent by at least 0.005
decision_rule.near_close: terminal validation CE at or below 5.5018, within 0.01 CE of attention-only
decision_rule.close: terminal validation CE at or below 5.4968, within 0.005 CE of attention-only
decision_rule.reject: instability, incomplete exact-resume state, MFU below 20 percent, scheduler identity failure, or terminal validation CE above 5.522365207672119
decision_rule.secondary_direction_support: at least two of three global coordinate cosines to the useful endpoint state exceed 0.10 and improve over the all-from-start control

implementation_gate.scope: pre-GELU, post-GELU hidden, and residual-output frame coordinates only; no base parameter is frozen
required_tests: updates before 120 preserve all three coordinate groups bitwise at zero and create no AdamW state for them
update 120 supplies finite nonzero gradients to all three coordinate groups without freezing c_fc or c_proj base gradients
interruption at update 119 followed by update 120 is bitwise identical for model, optimizer, training RNG, and frame coordinates
MFU preflight explicitly moves the delayed boundary into its scratch warmup so all active-frame overhead is timed

performance_gate.preflight: one warmup plus eight timed updates with the active-frame path executing on every timed update

required_artifacts: git commit, entrypoint, literal command, config/source/dataset/fixed-eval hashes
active-path MFU certificate and log hashes
terminal log, status, checkpoint, frame coordinates, and exact custom optimizer state hashes
